initialize_finetuning_model: initialize a finetuning model from a checkpoint with optional head overrides and strict loading
compute_loss: compute loss for a sequence of MLIP tasks given predictions and a batch of atomic data
compute_metrics: compute evaluation metrics for a given MLIP task using predictions and batched atomic data
MLIPTrainEvalUnit: create a train and eval unit for molecular machine learning models with DDP or FSDP strategy
MLIPEvalUnit: create an evaluation unit for molecular machine learning models to compute metrics on validation data
